text: The featuredActions range checks on action groups are critiques (warnings), not blocking constraints.
enabledBy, hiddenBy and requiredBy conditions must name a root-type attribute and a boolean attribute; they are constraints.
Date.of takes named numeric arguments year, month and day, e.g. Date.of(year = 2022, month = 1, day = 1).
Transfer relation declarations accept no selector modifier; the grammar allows default, eager, required, enabled, choices, create, update and delete.
View inputs use `widget <WidgetType> <name>`; `field` is not a view member.
View link accepts only visual, create-form, update-view and selector-table modifiers; required, enabled, default, choices, eager, delete and text are rejected.
View table accepts only action-group, visual, create-form, update-view and selector-table modifiers; enabled, default, choices, eager, create, delete, update and rows are not accepted.
The JSL validator does not reject binary primitives as identifiers; it rejects only calculated identifiers and numeric identifiers with scale.
